sql: with t as (select distinct o.market_ticker from live_orders o join fills f on f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Jmmsell10' and o.action='buy'), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, quantity, realized_pnl, market_exposure from positions where market_ticker in (select market_ticker from t) order by market_ticker, captured_at desc, id desc) select market_ticker, quantity, realized_pnl, market_exposure from p
